title: Good Sets
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC India Regionals, Online Preliminary Round 2016
statement: You are given array a consisting of n distinct integers. A set s of numbers is called good if you can rearrange the elements in such a way that each element divides the next element in the order, i.e. s i | s i + 1 , such that i < |s| , where |s| denotes size of set |s| .
